# ui::Computed

Header: `winui/core/Property.hpp`.

```cpp
template <typename T> class Computed
```

A read-only value derived from one or more sources: `fn(a, b, ...)`, computed now and again whenever any source changes. The sources are written out where it is declared, in the same shape as the several-source [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind); nothing is tracked behind the scenes.

It goes through the equality gate like a [Property](property.md), so its observers and the fields bound to it hear only about results that changed. It binds and observes like a [`const Property<T>`](property.md) (always one-way), and can be a source of another Computed, of [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) and of [ui::observe()](namespace-ui.md#observe).

It owns its edges to the sources, and either end may be destroyed first: a source destroyed before it keeps contributing its last value. Not copyable or movable, since the edges point at it. UI-thread only, as [Property](property.md) is.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> first;
ui::Property<std::string> last;
ui::Property<bool>        agreed{false};

ui::Computed can_submit{[](const std::string& f, const std::string& l, bool ok) {
                            return !f.empty() && !l.empty() && ok;
                        }, first, last, agreed};

window.set_content(ui::Button{.text = "Submit", .enabled = can_submit});
if (can_submit.get()) { save(); }
```

## value_type

```cpp
using ui::Computed< T >::value_type = T
```

The stored type.

## Computed

```cpp
template <typename Fn, typename... Ss>
Computed(Fn fn, const Ss& ... sources)
    requires (sizeof...(Ss) > 0) && (detail::is_source<Ss> && ...) && std::invocable<Fn&, const detail::source_value_t<Ss>&...> && std::convertible_to<std::invoke_result_t<Fn&, const detail::source_value_t<Ss>&...>, T> && (std::copy_constructible<detail::source_value_t<Ss>> && ...)
```

Computes `fn(sources.get()...)` now, then again whenever a source changes. `fn`'s result must convert to T.

## observe

```cpp
Subscription observe(Callback<void(const T&)> fn) const
```

Observe changes of the result, as [Property::observe()](property.md#observe): not called for the current value, and the [Subscription](subscription.md) must be kept for `fn` to keep firing.
